text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in AI, NLP, and machine learning, and I’d love to help with this video review.

I can create a natural, family-friendly video that shows how you read fairy tales with your child and explains how the app supports bedtime routines and helps kids love reading. I’ll keep the message warm, clear, and relatable for parents, while making sure it feels authentic and engaging for social media.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, so I’m comfortable working with AI-based products and explaining their value in simple terms.

I’d be happy to help you create a polished short video that fits your budget and goals.
